title: Echo hub
features:
Dominate the Leaderboard | 100% Performance Optimized | Undetected
​Stop losing your win streaks to sweaty players. Whether you’re grinding for Top 100 Global or just want to farm Keys and Skins, this script provides a professional-grade toolkit that turns every match into a victory.
​Equipped with a sleek, blur-responsive GUI and the fastest Silent Aim on the market, this is the last script you will ever need for Roblox Rivals.
​🎯 Aimbot & Combat Perfection
​The most advanced targeting system ever built for Rivals.
​Silent Aim (Method: Raycast): Hit every shot without your camera snapping. Targets are prioritized by proximity or lowest health.
​Adaptive Smoothing: Makes your aim look 100% natural to spectators and anti-cheat systems.
​Customizable FOV Circle: A dynamic overlay showing your kill zone—resize it to fit your playstyle.
​Hitbox Expansion: Increase enemy "head" and "torso" hitboxes by up to 5\times for easy snipes.
​Trigger Bot (ms Delay): Perfect for snipers. Fires the millisecond a pixel of an enemy crosses your reticle.
​Wallbang Mode: Penetrate thin surfaces and corners to catch enemies hiding in cover.
​No Recoil / No Spread: Every bullet goes exactly where the dot is. Zero bloom, zero kick.
​🏃 Movement & God-Tier Agility
​Become an untouchable ghost on the battlefield.
​Velocity Speedhack: Travel across the map in seconds. Includes a "Legit Mode" for subtle boosts.
​Infinite Double Jump: Scale any building and dominate the high-ground.
​Fly / No-Clip: Glide through the sky or walk through walls to surprise enemies from behind.
​Auto-Bhop: Maintains maximum momentum, making you a nightmare for manual aimers to track.
​Spinbot / Anti-Aim: Distort your character's hitbox to make it nearly impossible for other hackers to hit you.
​👁️ Visuals & Tactical Awareness (ESP)
​Full map control. Knowledge is power.
​Player ESP: View Health, Distance, Name, and Current Weapon held by every opponent.
​2D/3D Box & Skeleton: See exactly how an enemy is crouching or jumping behind a wall.
​Bullet Tracers: Beautiful RGB lines that track exactly where your (and your enemy's) shots are landing.
​Chams (Through-Wall Glow): Customizable colors and transparency (Pulse/Wireframe/Solid).
​Head Dots: A small marker on the enemy's head for manual aiming practice.
​Look Direction: See exactly where your opponent is looking on the map.
​⚙️ Automation & Progression
​Level up while you sleep.
​Auto-Queue: Instantly joins a new match the second the previous one ends.
​Kill Say / Trash Talk: Automatically sends customizable messages to the chat after every kill.
​Auto-Open Cases: Automatically burns through your earned crates to find Rare/Legendary skins.
​Config System: Save/Load your settings as .json files. Share your "God Settings" with friends.
​FPS Booster: Disables textures and shadows to ensure 240+ FPS during heavy combat.
